chunks: Sabah ibn Bashir ibn Yahya, al-Muqri', Abu Muhammad. Narrated from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon them). Zaydi.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far, referring to Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, referring to Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.زَيْدِيٌّ: Zaydi, a sect within Shia Islam

ai.seo_question: Who is Sabah ibn Bashir al-Muqri' and what is his classification in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry provides a biographical sketch of the narrator Sabah ibn Bashir ibn Yahya, identifying him as al-Muqri' (the reciter) and Abu Muhammad. It notes that he narrated from the two Imams, Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdillah, and classifies him as Zaydi.
